john-paulson.name: John Paulson

bill-gates.name: Bill Gates
bill-gates.bio_blurb: Co-founder of Microsoft. Has given away over $59B through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, focused on global health, poverty, and US education. One of history's most significant philanthropists — though the foundation's ties to pharmaceutical interests raise questions about agenda-setting.

mackenzie-scott.name: MacKenzie Scott
mackenzie-scott.bio_blurb: Ex-wife of Jeff Bezos who has given away over $17B since 2019 in unrestricted grants to nonprofits — at a pace and scale unmatched by nearly any other billionaire. Uses a trust model with minimal overhead. A genuine outlier in billionaire philanthropy.
